name: Cleveland Creek Home Furnishings
old_description: made from various types of wood. Please note that product shown here is only a fraction of what we offer.
about:
Cleveland Creek Home Furnishings operates from Broomfield, Colorado, with a warehouse in Golden and three retail showrooms in Golden, Boulder, and Lakewood. The company has been producing custom furniture for nearly two decades and is owned by Geoff Cleveland, who runs it as a locally owned, family-operated small business.

The shop specializes in custom handmade wood furniture and home accessories, covering bedroom, dining, living room, and office categories. Each piece is built to order using various wood species that the company says are locally and responsibly sourced. Production takes place at the Golden warehouse, while the showrooms display a fraction of the available designs; pricing varies by style and wood selection.

The primary customers are residential buyers, interior designers, and homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind pieces for private homes. The product line includes beds, dining tables, living room seating, and office furniture, all positioned as heirloom-quality items meant to last lifetimes.

The company states its mission is to provide furniture that is second to none, sourced and constructed in the most conscientious and responsible ways. Its vision ties continued growth to a focus on quality and customer satisfaction, with the goal of reinvesting in a expanding home accessory gallery.
